Apple_Scab.organic_remedy: Apply sulfur spray or neem oil during early bud break; prune lower canopy to increase airflow.
Apple_Scab.chemical_remedy: Apply preventative captan, myclobutanil, or mancozeb fungicides at green tip stage.
Apple_Scab.preventative: Rake and destroy fallen infected leaves in autumn; utilize resistant cultivars like Liberty or Enterprise.

Corn_Common_Rust.organic_remedy: Dust with wettable sulfur at first detection; remove severely infected lower leaves if localized.
Corn_Common_Rust.chemical_remedy: Apply strobilurin (azoxystrobin) or triazole (propiconazole) fungicides before tassel emergence.
Corn_Common_Rust.preventative: Plant rust-tolerant hybrid corn varieties; plant early in the season to evade peak airborne spore loads.

Potato_Early_Blight.organic_remedy: Apply copper octanoate or copper hydroxide spray bi-weekly; enhance soil organic matter and mulch.
Potato_Early_Blight.chemical_remedy: Foliar application of chlorothalonil, mancozeb, or boscalid following blossom drop.
Potato_Early_Blight.preventative: Maintain a strict 3 to 4-year crop rotation; avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation to keep foliage dry.

Potato_Late_Blight.organic_remedy: Apply fixed copper formulations immediately prior to humid wet periods; immediately rogue infected plants.
Potato_Late_Blight.chemical_remedy: Apply systemic fungicides containing cyazofamid, fluopicolide, or mandipropamid.
Potato_Late_Blight.preventative: Plant certified disease-free seed tubers; eliminate cull piles; destroy volunteer potato sprouts.

Tomato_Early_Blight.organic_remedy: Apply bio-fungicides (Bacillus subtilis) and liquid copper; prune lowest 12 inches of suckers/leaves.
Tomato_Early_Blight.chemical_remedy: Spray chlorothalonil, azoxystrobin, or difenoconazole on a 7-10 day cycle during warm, humid conditions.
Tomato_Early_Blight.preventative: Mulch soil surface around plants; stake and cage vines to elevate foliage away from splash zones.

Tomato_Late_Blight.organic_remedy: Spray preventative copper soap formulations; urgently bag and dispose of infected foliage.
Tomato_Late_Blight.chemical_remedy: Preventative and curative treatment with mefenoxam, cymoxanil, or propamocarb hydrochloride.
Tomato_Late_Blight.preventative: Ensure full sun exposure with adequate plant spacing; remove solanaceous weed hosts (e.g. nightshade).

Healthy_Leaf.organic_remedy: No disease remediation required. Maintain balanced compost tea or mild sea kelp extract application.
Healthy_Leaf.chemical_remedy: None needed. Maintain balanced N-P-K fertilization according to routine soil test recommendations.
Healthy_Leaf.preventative: Continue optimal drip irrigation, inspect undersides of foliage weekly for pest or pathogen inception.

Grape_Black_Rot.organic_remedy: Apply wettable sulfur or copper octanoate spray at 10-14 day intervals from budbreak to veraison; remove all mummified berries from vine and ground.
Grape_Black_Rot.chemical_remedy: Apply myclobutanil, azoxystrobin, or tebuconazole fungicides starting at early bloom.
Grape_Black_Rot.preventative: Prune and trellis vines to ensure canopy sunlight penetration and rapid leaf drying; destroy wild Vitis vines in vicinity.

Grape_Esca_Measles.display_name: Grape Esca / Black Measles (Phaeomoniella & Phaeoacremonium complex)
Grape_Esca_Measles.organic_remedy: Apply Trichoderma-based bio-protectants directly to pruning wounds; avoid heavy water-stress irrigations.
Grape_Esca_Measles.chemical_remedy: Apply wound sealant pastes containing thiophanate-methyl or boron immediately following winter pruning.
Grape_Esca_Measles.preventative: Sanitize pruning shears with 70% alcohol between vines; remove and burn severely declining vines.

Pepper_Bacterial_Spot.display_name: Bell Pepper Bacterial Spot (Xanthomonas campestris pv. vesicatoria)
Pepper_Bacterial_Spot.organic_remedy: Spray fixed copper hydroxide combined with Bacillus amyloliquefaciens biopesticide weekly.
Pepper_Bacterial_Spot.chemical_remedy: Apply copper bactericides tank-mixed with mancozeb to overcome copper-resistant bacterial strains.
Pepper_Bacterial_Spot.preventative: Plant certified disease-free hot-water treated seeds; enforce 2-year rotation with non-solanaceous crops.

Tomato_Bacterial_Spot.organic_remedy: Apply bio-fungicides containing Bacillus subtilis or bacteriophage products; prune diseased lower foliage.
Tomato_Bacterial_Spot.chemical_remedy: Foliar application of copper hydroxide mixed with actigard (acibenzolar-S-methyl) for systemic acquired resistance.
Tomato_Bacterial_Spot.preventative: Avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation; stake plants; sanitize stakes and trellises between seasons.

Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.display_name: Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus (TYLCV / Begomovirus)
Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.organic_remedy: Apply insecticidal soap, neem oil, or pyrethrins to suppress silverleaf whitefly (Bemisia tabaci) insect vectors.
Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.chemical_remedy: Rotate systemic insecticides such as imidacloprid, acetamiprid, or spiromesifen to control whitefly populations.
Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.preventative: Install 50-mesh insect exclusion netting in nurseries; immediately rogue and bag infected stunt plants; plant TYLCV-resistant hybrids.

Cherry_Powdery_Mildew.organic_remedy: Spray potassium bicarbonate or horticultural dormant oil at first sign of powdery talc mycelium.
Cherry_Powdery_Mildew.chemical_remedy: Apply quinoxyfen, myclobutanil, or flutriafol fungicides from shuck fall through harvest.
Cherry_Powdery_Mildew.preventative: Prune dense interior orchard canopy to improve air circulation; avoid excessive late-season nitrogen fertilization.

Peach_Bacterial_Spot.display_name: Peach Bacterial Spot (Xanthomonas arboricola pv. pruni)
Peach_Bacterial_Spot.organic_remedy: Apply dormant copper sulfate before bud swelling; apply zinc sulfate sprays in autumn.
Peach_Bacterial_Spot.chemical_remedy: Apply oxytetracycline (Mycoshield) sprays at petal fall on a 7-day schedule during wet, windy weather.
Peach_Bacterial_Spot.preventative: Plant resistant peach cultivars (e.g. Redhaven, Candor); plant windbreaks to minimize blowing sand leaf abrasions.

Strawberry_Leaf_Scorch.organic_remedy: Apply bio-fungicide sprays (Bacillus subtilis) and copper soaps; remove desiccated infected leaves.
Strawberry_Leaf_Scorch.chemical_remedy: Apply captan, pyraclostrobin, or cyprodinil fungicides post-harvest and during early spring crown flush.
Strawberry_Leaf_Scorch.preventative: Plant disease-free certified crowns; maintain adequate runner spacing to expedite foliage drying.

Corn_Northern_Leaf_Blight.organic_remedy: Apply copper formulations or microbial bio-inoculants; shred and deeply bury crop residues post-harvest.
Corn_Northern_Leaf_Blight.chemical_remedy: Apply strobilurin or triazole fungicides (e.g. pyraclostrobin + metconazole) prior to tassel emergence.
Corn_Northern_Leaf_Blight.preventative: Plant corn hybrids containing specific Ht resistance genes; practice minimum 1-year rotation away from maize.

Citrus_Greening.organic_remedy: Intense foliar micronutrient feeding (zinc, manganese, iron) to sustain tree vigor; release Tamarixia radiata parasitoid wasps.
Citrus_Greening.chemical_remedy: Systemic trunk injection with oxytetracycline; rigorous vector control using imidacloprid against Asian Citrus Psyllid.
Citrus_Greening.preventative: Plant only certified disease-free nursery stock in enclosed screen houses; monitor psyllid populations with yellow sticky traps.

Squash_Powdery_Mildew.organic_remedy: Spray sulfur dust, dilute milk spray (10-20%), or potassium bicarbonate solution on upper and lower leaf surfaces.
Squash_Powdery_Mildew.chemical_remedy: Apply chlorothalonil, triflumizole, or boscalid fungicides at the first sign of white talcum colonies.
Squash_Powdery_Mildew.preventative: Plant powdery mildew tolerant cucurbit cultivars; ensure wide plant spacing for sunlight and airflow.
